task.problem_statement: The fermionic sample-based diagonalization interface requires Qiskit BitArray samples. Users with samples already stored in NumPy boolean arrays need to pass them directly into the same quantum-chemistry workflow.
requirements: Accept a two-dimensional NumPy boolean array of sampled bitstrings as the solver input.
Interpret those samples consistently with the existing bitstring convention and recover the molecular ground-state energy.
Preserve existing BitArray input, determinant conversion, and subspace-size controls.

interface.Name: diagonalize_fermionic_hamiltonian
interface.Input: one_body_tensor, two_body_tensor, bit_array, samples_per_batch, norb, nelec, *, max_iterations=100, seed=None, ...
interface.Description: Accepts BitArray or a NumPy boolean sample array; result.energy is the electronic energy before adding nuclear repulsion.
